description: Opt-in add-on for a repository that is itself a docs site, with its package.json at the repository root. Gives the whole npm tree the treatment the default preset gives docs/**. Extend it after the default preset.

packageRules.description: Every npm update, majors included, opens without dashboard approval and automerges once the site build passes. The site is not shipped as a package, so a major that breaks the build stops on the check and one that only changes rendering lands. GitHub Actions and the workflow's node-version stay on the default rules.
